description: This file contains shell script functions for extracting variables from a Makefile, checking for missing documentation for commands, checking for extraneous documentation, and performing validation on command documentation and links within the project.

methods.name: extract_variable
methods.description: Extracts the value of a variable from the Makefile or generated output.

methods.name: check_missing_docs
methods.description: Checks whether commands have corresponding documentation and links.

methods.name: check_extraneous_docs
methods.description: Validates that documentation files correspond to actual commands and removes outdated references.
